Lesson 1: Sliced Peaches is the first daily quest available from Nomi. Upon reaching the next "level" at 8,400 reputation, the player moves on to Lesson 2: Instant Noodles.
Lesson 2: Instant Noodles becomes available at 8,400 reputation with Nomi, replacing the first lesson. The player will move on to Lesson 3: Toasted Fish Jerky upon reaching 16,800 reputation.

Lesson 3: Toasted Fish Jerky becomes available at 25,200 reputation with Nomi, replacing the second lesson. The player will move on to Lesson 4: Dried Needle Mushrooms upon reaching 33,600 reputation.
Lesson 4: Dried Needle Mushrooms becomes available at 33,600 reputation with Nomi, replacing the third lesson. The player will move on to Lesson 5: Pounded Rice Cake upon reaching 42,000 reputation.
Lesson 5: Pounded Rice Cake becomes available at 42,000 reputation with Nomi, replacing the fourth lesson. The player will move on to A Present for Teacher upon reaching 50,400 reputation.

LibStub is a minimalistic versioning library embedded by thousands of other addons. It allows addons to more easily share libraries by checking for the most recent version and making it available to other installed addons. This cross-community library-sharing system was creditted to Kaelten, Cladhaire, ckknight, Mikk, Ammo, Nevcairiel and joshborke; and has resided in the Public Domain since c. 2007.
Liam Trollbane was the father of Thoras Trollbane, and grandfather of Galen and Danath.

Lady Lianne Menethil was the wife of King Terenas Menethil II, mother of Calia and Arthas, and queen consort of Lordaeron. Lianne was present in a church service where Arthas met Jaina Proudmoore for the first time. Years later, when Arthas and Jaina were in love and once, Lianne took Calia and Jaina to be fitted for the formal dresses fashion required for the Winter Veil Eve ball. After Calia secretly married and got pregnant, she confided in Lianne. Lianne was furious at first, but she eventually saw the love in Calia's face. She would sometimes take her daughter "to remote parts of the kingdom to enjoy a rest." It was then that Calia would spend time with her husband and daughter. Lianne

Liana was a resident of Andorhal when Arthas, having just killed his father and betrayed his people, came through and slaughtered Uther and the other Paladins guarding his father's urn. She lived on a farm just outside town with Dirk.

Lieutenant is used in the names and ranks of different races. In World of Warcraft, there are some people with Lieutenant in their name. Lieutenant can also mean a subordinate of a leader, even if they have no official rank or have a higher rank, as was the case with Uther the Lightbringer, Admiral Daelin Proudmoore, and Turalyon being the lieutenants of Lothar during the Second War. In Warcraft: Orcs & Humans and Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness, it is a rank you can achieve.

Liberated Karabor Prisoners are draenei located in Tanaan Jungle during the Assault on the Dark Portal.
Librams of Fel Knowledge are tomes found in Azsuna and on the Broken Shore.
The Leywalker Aurora is a quest reward from They Came From the Sea.
The Leywalker Cord is a quest reward from They Came From the Sea.
The Leywalker Wristwraps are a quest reward from The Nightborne Prince.
The Leywalker Halo is a quest reward from The Nightborne Prince.
The Leywalker Handwraps are a quest reward from Feasting on the Dragon.
Leyline Feed Fragments drop from Volatile Leywraiths in Suramar for Leyline Feed: Ley Station Aethenar.
Leyline Spiderlings are spider demons located in Suramar. Some of them are summoned by Fal'dorei Broodcallers and Fal'dorei Broodlords.
__NOTOC__ Lichenjaw Saurolisks are saurolisks located in the Fogcliff Strand in Tiragarde Sound.
The Leywalker Shoes are a quest reward from The Scythe of Souls.
The Leyspine naga are a cut group that would appear on the Broken Isles.
Leystone Basilisks are basilisks located on the Broken Isles.
The Leywalker Leggings are a quest reward from Our Very Bones.
The Leywalker Waistwrap is a quest reward from The Prince is Going Down.
Leystone-Encrusted Spikes drop from Leystone Basilisks on the Broken Isles.

The Leyweavers are nightborne tailors. They are organized in a guild. Adventurers can also become leyweavers during the Legion tailoring questline. Some of them sell Runic Catgut and Sharp Spritethorn.
The Leyweavers' Sharpened Spritethorns were never made available.
The Liberated Idol of Binding is a quest reward from The Grinning Idols.
Li'zal is a Zandalari troll located in Warbeast Kraal in Zuldazar.
Licorice is a sea snail located in Maedin's Challenge in Nazjatar.
The Leycoral Shard is created with the following tokens: *Relinquished Trinket *Relinquished Trinket (880)
Liberated Naga Cache is a reward from the following quests: *Hidden, But Dangerous *The Mystic Chest *Treasure To Find
Liberator's Might is an Azerite trait available to all classes. It can only be found on Alliance Azerite Armor from the Arathi Highlands, the Battle for Stromgarde, or PvP content.
Leywalker Gloves are a quest reward from Their Dying Breaths.
Lichsworn Commander's Boneblade drops from Nerissa Heartless in Maldraxxus.
Liadrin's Scouting Report was to be rewarded from a Class Hall missions. Its internal quest was This Is Not a Quest.
Leyflame Burner is part of Deucus Valdera's alchemy table. It is a ley-charged version of a Depleted Leyflame Burner and is used to help craft newfound alchemy recipes.

The Liberated Forsworn are two non-hostile Forsworn located in the main hall of the Seat of the Primus alongside Alexandros Mograine and other kyrian characters during Filling an Empty Throne and The Roads We Walk. One is standing next to Kynthia while the other is seated and seemingly being tended to by Aspirant Thales. Along with Fallen Disciple Nikolon, they represent the Forsworn who were rescued from Helgarde Keep by the player character in Forsworn and Forgotten.
Lichbone Legguards drop from Nalthor the Rimebinder in The Necrotic Wake.
__NOTOC__ Lichsworn Champions are Maldraxxi skeletons located in the House of Rituals in Maldraxxus.
Liastrin's Wine Taster is a quest reward from Challiane Vineyards.
Leywalker Bracers are a quest reward from The Headmistress' Keys.
Leza's Totem is a totem found in Thunder Cleft in the Krasarang Wilds after Life (quest). Clicking on it replays the cutscene of said quest.
The Lichsworn are a subgroup of the House of Rituals found in Maldraxxus. They are under the command of Nerissa Heartless, and their members are part of Kel'Thuzad's forces.
Lichsworn Defenders are Maldraxxi skeletons located in Revendreth.
__NOTOC__ Lichsworn Failures are Maldraxxi skeletons located in the House of Rituals in Maldraxxus.
Lichsworn Guards are Maldraxxi skeletons located in Maldraxxus.
__NOTOC__ Lichsworn Guardians are Maldraxxi skeletons located in the House of Rituals in Maldraxxus.
__NOTOC__ Lichsworn Menials are Maldraxxi skeletons located in Maldraxxus.
Lichsworn Necromancers are Maldraxxi necromancers located in Revendreth.
